fact: President Barrow said in the 2025 State of the Nation Address that ID cards will be integrated with the Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system, passport and other databases into a unified digital ID system.

The World Bank says the Interior Ministry's national ID system was integrated with the Health Ministry's civil registration through an eCRVS that generates a unique national identification number at registration.
